game.title: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition

roadmap.title: Prologue and Old Villedor start
roadmap.description: Take the Prologue memento, then play the early story. Craft, mod a weapon, use your first Inhibitor and reach the Bazaar.

roadmap.title: Story to the Central Loop
roadmap.description: Before Water Tower and Revolution, finish side quests and pick a faction for the facilities. Capture the first camp, windmill, metro station and night kill.

roadmap.title: Late story, open world and grind
roadmap.description: Finish the story, then sweep every district for collectibles and points of interest, and grind counters in co-op and free roam.

roadmap.title: Bloody Ties
roadmap.description: Play the Bloody Ties story in Carnage Hall, then earn the gold medals and collect the Hall's items.

steps.text: Follow the main story from the start until you arrive in Villedor.

achievements.description: Use an Inhibitor for the first time.
achievements.summary: Spend your first Inhibitor on a Health or Stamina upgrade.

guide.context: Hakon gives you your first Inhibitor early in the story.

steps.text: Open the skills menu and spend one Inhibitor on a Health or Stamina upgrade.

guide.context: It unlocks after the hospital night trip with Hakon, when you go to the Church.

steps.text: Follow the main story until you reach the Bazaar.

guide.context: Stop before this mission and finish your side quests. Which faction gets the tower is a permanent choice and several side quests are lost afterwards.

steps.text: Finish the story mission Water Tower to turn on the Horseshoe Water Tower.

achievements.displayName: On the Trail of the Enemy

steps.text: Follow the main story until you learn Waltz's location.
Finish the story mission A Place to Call Home to turn on the Downtown Electrical Station.

achievements.description: Defeat the Renegades attacking the Fish Eye.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Renegades attacking the Fish Eye.

steps.text: Follow the main story and defeat the Renegades attacking the Fish Eye.

guide.context: Finish the side quest Renegades before you complete the story mission Observatory, or it fails.

steps.text: Follow the main story until you reach the Observatory.
Follow the main story and restore the radio broadcast tower in the story mission Broadcast.
Follow the main story until you learn Veronika Ryan's location.

achievements.description: Wake up after the missile strike.
achievements.summary: Wake up after the missile strike.

steps.text: Follow the main story until you wake up after the missile strike.

guide.context: Collect the Archivist and Audiophile items from the main story before the story mission X13.

steps.text: Follow the main story until you enter the X-13 elevator.
Follow the main story until you find your sister.

achievements.description: Complete the game with any ending.
achievements.summary: Finish the game with any ending.

steps.text: Finish the story and choose any ending.

achievements.summary: Assign all 7 facilities (Water Towers and Electrical Stations) to a faction.

guide.context: Each facility goes to the Survivors or the Peacekeepers. For Boot Licker, give all 7 to the same faction.

collectibles.name: Horseshoe Water Tower
collectibles.method: Assigned in the story mission Water Tower.

collectibles.name: Downtown Electrical Station
collectibles.method: Assigned in the story mission A Place to Call Home.

collectibles.name: Garrison Electrical Station
collectibles.method: Assigned in the story mission Broadcast.

collectibles.name: Houndfield Electrical Station
collectibles.location: Houndfield, enter through the broken windows halfway up
collectibles.method: Connect cable 2 in the basement, then cable 1 upstairs. Take the lift up to the control room and use the terminal.

collectibles.name: Wharf Water Tower
collectibles.location: Muddy Grounds, enter the yard over the west wall
collectibles.method: Go in through the green container building, climb the pipes and bridges to the top floor and turn the valve.

collectibles.name: Saint Paul Electrical Station
collectibles.location: Saint Paul Island, climb the east chimney to the broken windows
collectibles.method: Connect cables 1, 2, 3, A, B and C underwater, take the lift up and use the control room console.

collectibles.name: Saint Paul Water Tower
collectibles.method: Climb to the top with Tic Tac, Wall Run and Wall Run Jump, then turn the valve.

guide.context: The Holy Trinity and Downtown Court activate by themselves in the story mission Let's Waltz.

steps.text: Reach Hayward Square in Houndfield, open its gates and flip the power switch to activate it.

guide.context: Stations need power switches and, in most, generators. Bring lockpicks.

collectibles.name: Metro: Hayward Square
collectibles.method: Squeeze through the boards at the entrance, open the gates and lift the gate in the far-left room. Flip the power switch.

collectibles.name: Metro: The Holy Trinity
collectibles.method: Activates itself in the story mission Let's Waltz.

collectibles.name: Metro: Downtown Court
collectibles.method: Activates itself in the story mission Let's Waltz. If its map icon turns back to a question mark, walk back in to restore it.

collectibles.name: Metro: Waterside
collectibles.method: Lockpick the door, flip the switch, drop down the elevator and turn on 4 generators, then ride up and flip the last switch.

collectibles.name: Metro: Newalls Crossing
collectibles.method: Lockpick the door, flip the switch, drop down and turn on 3 generators, then the one in the centre. Opens through the side quest Rats in the House.

collectibles.name: Metro: VNC Tower
collectibles.method: Run past the humans, lockpick the door at the end and flip the switch.

collectibles.name: Metro: King William Bridge
collectibles.method: Climb over the train to reach the locked door, lockpick it, flip the switch, drop down and turn on the generators.

collectibles.name: Metro: Cathedral
collectibles.method: Lockpick the door, flip the switch, drop down, turn on 5 generators clockwise, then the centre one, and ride up.

collectibles.name: Metro: South Loop
collectibles.method: The door is open. Flip the switch, drop down, turn on 4 generators clockwise, then the centre one, and ride up.

guide.context: Larch is climbed for you in the story mission Unruly Brother.

steps.text: Climb any Windmill and flip the circuit box at the top.

achievements.description: Use a Metro Station to Fast Travel.
achievements.summary: Fast travel from a Metro Station.

steps.text: Activate any Metro Station, open the map and fast travel from it.

guide.context: Clear nearby enemies first or the circuit box will not work. Some climbs need more Stamina.

collectibles.name: Birch Windmill
collectibles.method: Climb the side boards, swing across the moving weights to the balcony and climb the ladder.

collectibles.name: Cherry Windmill
collectibles.method: Needs about 220 Stamina. Jump between the wall and the moving weight to the balcony, climb the boards and the ladder.

collectibles.name: Larch Windmill
collectibles.method: Climbed automatically in the story mission Unruly Brother.

collectibles.name: Alder Windmill
collectibles.method: Use the yellow jump pad to boost-jump to the moving platform, then the balcony and ladder.

collectibles.name: Willow Windmill
collectibles.method: Climb the chimney, jump across two moving weights to the balcony, crouch through the wall hole and climb the ladder.

collectibles.name: Maple Windmill
collectibles.method: Climb the big centre weight and jump off at the top.

collectibles.name: Oak Windmill
collectibles.method: Climb the moving weights and jump off to the balconies.

collectibles.name: Walnut Windmill
collectibles.method: Use the moving monkey bar twice to reach the balconies, then the ladder.

collectibles.name: Pine Windmill
collectibles.method: Jump from the boards to the monkey bar, shimmy left, swing to the balcony, then climb.

collectibles.name: Teak Windmill
collectibles.method: Needs about 220 Stamina. Weight, rope, second weight, balcony, ladder.

collectibles.name: Juniper Windmill
collectibles.method: Clear the enemies below first. Needs about 260 Stamina. Chain the moving monkey bars to the balcony.

collectibles.name: Hickory Windmill
collectibles.method: Clear the enemies below first. Needs about 260 Stamina. Time the monkey bars, then jump to the balcony.

collectibles.name: Elm Windmill
collectibles.method: Clear the enemies below first. Stand in the second-farthest air vent north-west of it, open the glider and cross the nearest vent for the boost.

collectibles.name: Magnolia Windmill
collectibles.method: Use the fuse box below to stop the moving bar by the tarp balcony, swing to the fixed bar and the balcony, then use the next fuse box.

collectibles.name: Ash Windmill
collectibles.method: Clear the enemies below first. Ride the moving weight up to the side balcony, then hop to the bigger weight.

collectibles.name: Cedar Windmill
collectibles.method: Flip the switch at the bottom to move the big weight, ride it to the top and cross the monkey bars.

collectibles.name: Spruce Windmill
collectibles.method: Go up the cathedral's south face to the roof, then glide over to the windmill. You do not need the grappling hook.

achievements.description: Collect all Inhibitors hidden in GRE Quarantines.
achievements.summary: Collect all 24 Inhibitors in the 6 GRE Quarantine buildings.

guide.context: Each building has 3 chests holding 1, 1 and 2 Inhibitors. Night has fewer enemies inside.

collectibles.location: Lower Dam Ayre, enter from the rooftop
collectibles.method: Use the GRE access point on the roof, open all 3 Inhibitor chests by following the yellow cable down (1, 1 and 2 Inhibitors).

achievements.displayName: It Wasn't That Hard, Was It?

steps.text: Sleep until night in a bed, then go to a marked anomaly without starting a chase.
Defeat the monster. Each chest holds 2 Inhibitors.

guide.context: They only appear at night. Each drops 2 Inhibitors.

guide.context: Any later camp also counts.

steps.text: Clear Jack & Joe's Camp in the story mission The Raid.

guide.context: Kill the lieutenants, then turn the crank that lowers the flag.

collectibles.name: Jack & Joe's Camp
collectibles.method: Cleared in the story mission The Raid.

collectibles.name: Downtown Thugs
collectibles.method: Climb the rooftops, kill the lieutenants and turn the crank to lower the flag.
collectibles.note: Do not clear it before To Kill or Not to Kill shows up.

collectibles.name: Garrison Heights
collectibles.method: Ride the ropes up, climb the tallest skyscraper, kill the lieutenants and turn the crank.

collectibles.name: Heron Renegados
collectibles.method: Cross the bridge and suspension bridges, kill the lieutenants (the hardest camp) and turn the crank.
collectibles.note: Clearing it early can remove the side quest Could You Repeat?

achievements.summary: Craft an item for the first time.

steps.text: Craft a Medic Kit with honey and chamomile in the Prologue.

achievements.displayName: Oh, So This Is How It Works!
achievements.description: Modify your weapon for the first time.
achievements.summary: Modify a weapon for the first time.

steps.text: Open the inventory and add a mod to a weapon that shows a small circle on its icon.

guide.context: Encounters appear at random within about 50 metres.

steps.text: Roam the city and join Encounters, where survivors are attacked. Defeat the attackers until you have helped 50.

guide.context: The level grows from using parkour moves. Inhibitors are not needed.

steps.text: Keep doing parkour moves until you reach Parkour level 25.

guide.context: The level grows from using combat moves. Inhibitors are not needed.

steps.text: Keep fighting until you reach Combat level 25.

achievements.description: Reach City Alignment 7 for any faction.
achievements.summary: Reach City Alignment 7 with one faction.

guide.context: Each facility you assign adds 1 alignment level, so all 7 facilities must go to the same faction. The choice at Water Tower cannot be undone. If the achievement does not unlock, joining another player's session has fixed it for some players.

steps.text: Before the story mission Water Tower, choose the faction you want to side with.
Give the Horseshoe Water Tower, the Downtown Electrical Station and the other facilities to that faction every time.

achievements.summary: Collect 1,000,000 Old World Money in total.

guide.context: The total counts all earnings. Selling a rare item and buying it back repeats the progress.

steps.text: Sell valuable items, mods and weapons to merchants until your total earnings reach 1,000,000.

achievements.description: Meet all your Sparker love interests.

guide.context: Finish the side quest The Matchmaker first; it opens after the story mission The Raid and gives you Aiden's Dating Card. Wait 24 in-game hours between meetings as needed. Finish the side quest Sentimental Value before the story mission Water Tower, because it is lost afterwards and Maya needs it. If you skip it, Maya may never appear, but talking to Vinnie may still unlock the achievement.

collectibles.name: Juliet
collectibles.location: Rooftop of the Matchmaker's Bakery settlement, Trinity
collectibles.method: Return there 24 in-game hours after finishing The Matchmaker, and talk to her.

collectibles.name: Vinnie
collectibles.method: Return after finishing Welcome on Board and talk to him. His marker shows only within 25 m.

collectibles.name: Maya
collectibles.method: Finish the side quest Sentimental Value, return and talk to her. The unlock can arrive 5 to 30 minutes later.

guide.context: Sprinting, dashing, swimming, climbing, lifts and the VNC Tower elevator count. Falling, the paraglider, fast travel, zip lines and the grappling hook do not. The Extras menu shows your distance.

steps.text: Run, climb and swim around the world until your travel distance reaches 960 km.

achievements.description: Fall from a combined height of at least 10,994 meters.

steps.text: Jump from tall buildings again and again until your total fall height reaches 10,994 metres.
Stay alive outside the story missions until the sun rises.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies in a row with melee weapons without taking damage.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies in a row with melee weapons without taking damage.

guide.context: The hospital area in Markers of Plague is an easy place to try this. A lower difficulty helps.

steps.text: Fight one enemy at a time and use blocks and dodges, or lead zombies into narrow passages.
If you are hit, start the count again.
Find a Volatile at night or in a story mission and kill it, ideally with a ranged weapon.

achievements.description: Kill a Spitter using a ranged weapon.
achievements.summary: Kill a Spitter with a ranged weapon.

steps.text: Shoot a Spitter with a bow, throwing knife or other ranged weapon until it dies.

achievements.description: Use the UV Flashlight to kill a Viral.
achievements.summary: Kill a Viral with the UV Flashlight.

steps.text: Upgrade the UV Flashlight to level 3 at a craftmaster.
Hit a Viral with the UV Flashlight until it dies.

achievements.description: Perform 50 headshots with a ranged weapon.

steps.text: Aim for the head with bows, throwing spears or throwing knives until you have landed 50 headshots.

achievements.description: Lose the maximum level of Chase.
achievements.summary: Lose a chase at the highest level.

guide.context: At chase level 3 a Volatile joins the Virals.

steps.text: Get a chase to level 4 at night.
Run to a safe zone or far away until the chase ends.
Use Find Game or join a friend's session.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies while playing with at least 2 other players.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies in co-op with at least 2 other players.

steps.text: Play in a session with at least 2 other players and kill 100 enemies together.

achievements.description: Perform a Perfect Block 10 times in a row without taking damage.
achievements.summary: Perfect Block 10 times in a row without taking damage.

steps.text: Learn the Perfect Parry skill in the Combat tree.
Fight a single basic bandit, parry every attack and do not attack in between. If you take a hit, start again.

achievements.description: Modify your weapons at least 50 times.

steps.text: Add or change weapon mods until you have modified weapons 50 times.

guide.context: The game has too few Inhibitors to max both Health and Stamina in one run. Keep a save backup, max one stat, restore the backup and max the other. After the story, missing Inhibitors can still be found.

steps.text: Save about 80 Inhibitors without spending them, and back up your save.
Spend them all on Health, then restore the backup if you also want Ironheart.

guide.context: The game has too few Inhibitors to max both Health and Stamina in one run. Keep a save backup, max one stat, restore the backup and max the other.

steps.text: Save about 80 Inhibitors without spending them, and back up your save.
Spend them all on Stamina, then restore the backup if you also want Fit as a Fiddle.

guide.context: The achievement can unlock a while after the 50th takedown.

steps.text: Sneak behind an unaware enemy and press the takedown prompt. Repeat 50 times.

achievements.description: Perform Smash on at least 50 enemies.

steps.text: Unlock Vault Kick, reach 200 Health and unlock Smash.
Jump on an enemy from a height and use Smash to crush the head. Do this to 50 enemies.
Pick up throwing spears from bodies and around the world.
Kill enemies with them until you reach 50 kills.

guide.context: Bronze is enough. Good Stamina helps.

steps.text: Find each Nightrunner Trial and finish it with at least a bronze medal. Repeat for all 10 trials.

achievements.description: Perform an Air Kick after a Double Wall Run.
achievements.summary: Kick an enemy in the air after a double wall run.

steps.text: Unlock Air Kick and the wall-run skills Tic Tac and Wall Run.
Run on one wall, bounce to the opposite wall and run on it, then bounce off turning toward an enemy and use Air Kick.

guide.context: Mementos are in the Collectables menu. Use Survival Sense to mark them. Only the first Prologue note cannot be recovered; the rest can be taken in another player's session.

steps.text: Follow the Bloody Ties story until you meet Skullface.
Follow the Bloody Ties story until you arrive at Carnage Hall.
Follow the Bloody Ties story and live through the Night of Terrors.
Follow the Bloody Ties story until you choose what happens to Ciro.
Follow the Bloody Ties story to the final fight and defeat Skullface.

achievements.description: Earn a gold medal in all 'Madmen of Villedor' trials.
achievements.summary: Earn a gold medal in all 3 Madmen of Villedor trials.

guide.context: Replay a trial if the medal is not gold.

steps.text: Play the Madmen of Villedor quest in Bloody Ties.
Earn gold in each trial: Like the Wind, Between Two Fires and Treasure Hunt.

achievements.description: Earn a gold medal in all Carnage Hall shows.
achievements.summary: Earn a gold medal in all 12 Carnage Hall shows.

steps.text: Earn gold in the four combat shows: Trouble In Harran, Riot In The Castle, Bedlam In Babel and Forge Of Mayhem.
Earn gold in the four parkour shows: Run Boy Run, Man In Tights, Running Up That Tower and God Of Speed.
Earn gold in the four boss shows: Abandon All Hope, Prim-Ate, Phantom Of The Opera and Brawl In The Bog.

achievements.summary: Find all 36 Carnage Hall collectibles (4 tapes and 32 mementos).

guide.context: Backstory comes from Rune. The Only Hope starts when you talk to Ogar in the metro at the start of Road to Perdition. Portrait of a Hangover comes from Severus; take the side options he offers instead of continuing the tournament. A Gilded Cage cannot be re-entered after you finish it.

steps.text: Pick up every collectible you see in Carnage Hall; scan with Survival Sense.
Accept the side quests Backstory, The Only Hope and Portrait of a Hangover and finish them.
Finish A Gilded Cage before you leave its area.
